fig_raw_gain_associations: Associations between FDRatio gain and downstream improvement relative to NoExplore at risk-budget proportion 0.10. Points are within-dataset Spearman correlations over 40 terminal policy cells (four policies, ten seeds); bars are 95% percentile intervals from 10,000 whole-seed bootstrap resamples. Recall gain is policy minus NoExplore; Brier improvement reverses that subtraction. These descriptive policy-level associations do not identify a causal effect of feedback composition.
